description: A utility class managing a message queue for a specific entity, ensuring thread-safe processing with semaphore synchronization. It handles asynchronous message processing, validation, and callback handling within the Thingsboard rule engine context.

classes.name: SemaphoreWithTbMsgQueue
classes.description: Manages a per-entity message queue with semaphore-based synchronization, processing messages asynchronously with callback handling.

classes.name: TbMsgTbContextBiFunction
classes.description: A record encapsulating a message, context, and processing function for queue operations.

methods.name: addToQueueAndTryProcess
methods.description: Adds a message to the queue and initiates processing if possible.

methods.name: tryProcessQueue
methods.description: Attempts to process the next message in the queue, respecting semaphore availability and handling asynchronous callbacks.
